messages:
jana_csm: Quick heads-up 1 FloraAI needs a short, auditable config change for a compliance demo on 2025-08-12. Request: pin routing to eu-north-1 (for data residency), allowlist two /28 CIDRs for partner test clients, and increase QPS on /v1/chat-completions by 2.2x for 90 minutes. This demo is tied to an upcoming renewal conversaton 1 can we fast-track?

rachel_support: Ack. Please paste exact CIDRs, org id, models/routes, window, and whether they want auto-revoke. Also flagging @zara_security for quick review because they mentioned data residency.

flora_ops: Org id: org_flora_004. CIDRs: 192.0.2.16/28 and 192.0.2.32/28. Routes: /v1/chat-completions (models using redwood-chat-2). Window: 2025-08-12T09:00:00Z -> 2025-08-12T10:30:00Z. Auto-revoke: yes. Demo contact: demo@flora.ai. Note: they require region pin to eu-north-1 and an audit log entry for policy change.

oliver_oncall: Plan: 1) add ACL entries to proxy for the two CIDR blocks, 2) apply region_pin eu-north-1 for org_flora_004 (allow fallback to eu-west only if strict pin fails), 3) set per-route qps_override=2.2 for /v1/chat-completions, 4) tag policy change with audit metadata and schedule expire at 10:30Z. Tagging @zara_security for explicit ok on residency + ACLs.

zara_security: Quick review: CIDRs look like partner test ranges, approved. Confirming we should capture audit metadata with field:initiated_by=jana_csm and reason=demo-compliance. Approve region pin and temp QPS with auto-revoke. One caveat: add rate limit ceiling of 2000 concurrent requests for that route to avoid autoscale OOM on older workers.

rachel_support: Running a staging patch and smoke then will push to eu-north-1. Staging command:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_flora_004 \
  --patch '{"region_pin":"eu-north-1","routes":{"/v1/chat-completions":{"qps_override":2.2,"concurrency_cap":2000}},"acls":["192.0.2.16/28","192.0.2.32/28"]}' \
  --region eu-north-1 --expires 2025-08-12T10:30:00Z --audit "initiated_by=jana_csm;reason=demo-compliance"
```

rachel_support: staging smoke passed. Pushing to eu-north-1 in ~45s, will drop console link and policy ref here.

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-08-11T22:12:03Z actor=rachel_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=rachel_support status=success time=2025-08-11T22:13:46Z ref=patch-104412

oliver_oncall: Verified ACLs + region pin + qps_override live in eu-north-1. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-08-12T10:30:00Z. Audit metadata present. I'll monitor p50/p95, errors, and token burn during the window and report anomalies here.

flora_ops: Warmup looks good 1 thank you! If demo goes well we'd like a formal follow-up on Dedicated and SLA tiers. Also noted request to reduce long-term token cost.

jana_csm: I'll add to the renewal tracker and schedule a technical follow-up with product if the demo converts. Closing loop for now 1 great turnaround, team :tada:
